description: A fake 'arrest warrant' SMS with a link lands, then the call. The flagged SMS adds risk and the message is flagged.

events.text: URGENT: Arrest warrant issued in your name, money laundering case. Verify here https://cbi-verify.xyz/pay or face arrest.
Sir main inspector bol raha hoon, aapke warrant ke baare mein. Kisi ko mat batana, abhi paise transfer karo.
events.speaker: caller
